description: Offre de FTO sur les liens en fibre optique en LR is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by amigo.siglr.org. Offer from France Télécom Orange on fibre optic links. The form file has polylines representing the fiber optic links between two NRAs and the attribute table has a field on the availability or not of the fiber optic on this path. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "FTO offer on fiber optic links in LR" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2012-05-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
